images.author: RCSB PDB; structural data: L. Xing et al.
images.why: Scientific 3D fallback: coloured rendering of the hepatitis E virion-sized capsid, based on a 10.5 Å cryo-EM reconstruction. Compact spherical composition suits a 9:10 crop. Image dimensions ≥1600 px could not be verified. Licence stated in https://www.rcsb.org/pages/policies.

images.author: RCSB PDB; structural data: T. S. Y. Guu et al.
images.why: Scientific 3D fallback: coloured rendering of a hepatitis E virus-like particle, based on its 3.50 Å crystal structure. Represents an experimentally assembled capsid rather than an infectious virion. Compact composition suits a near-square card; dimensions ≥1600 px could not be verified. Licence stated in https://www.rcsb.org/pages/policies.
